candidate: Canonical M27 plus degree-normalized current-geometry modulation of the existing backbone graph
pain_point: M27 reuses one static netlist adjacency across every ODE call and all 12 backbone layers. U1 changed only the final 3D output and did not preserve legalized structure.
mechanism: A zero-initialized sparse edge encoder maps active b2b center deltas, aspect deltas, area ratios and net weights to a bounded symmetric adjacency residual. Degree normalization matches the static graph scale, and the residual modulates the existing Trinity graph-mix and attention bias at every trajectory call.

engineering_history.v1: The first run summed edge scores without degree normalization. It remained finite on most cases but overflowed two 108/119-block cases. Disabling the dynamic path on the same trained checkpoint restored finite rollouts, so v1 is an invalid unnormalized implementation rather than a mechanism result.
engineering_history.v2: Each row now uses the mean active-edge score. All 500 dev curve rollouts are finite.

decision: Reject all-layer state-conditioned graph modulation. A small train-curve gain did not survive legalization and compounded through all 12 blocks. Do not sweep activation layers, bottleneck width or residual scale.
boundary: Frozen subset mechanism screen only; not a full-data or external-PPA claim.
